title: SCAMPER — Eberle's creativity checklist
problem_statement: Brainstorming produces shallow variations without a forcing function. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Invention dossier: SCAMPER (Bob Eberle): Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to other uses, Eliminate, Reverse — seven prompts that force a concept through transformations.
novelty_assessment: Directed creativity: the checklist does the diverging for you.
constraints: Needs a seed concept to transform
validation_plan: Run SCAMPER vs free brainstorming; count viable ideas
Document the outcome honestly whether it confirms or kills the concept.
